as_told.title: Miethe and the Avro Canada Avrocar

plain: A German aircraft engineer named Richard Miethe, said to have worked on Nazi flying-disc projects, ended up in Canada in the 1950s on a saucer-shaped aircraft project, the Avrocar, led by an engineer named John Frost. Michels tells this himself across three episodes: in one he says the project was British-linked and run in partnership with the American CIA, the US spy agency; in another he says Miethe was the man captured by an American inventor and CIA-linked scientist named Townsend Brown, and does not mention the CIA's role; in a third he calls Miethe's work on it only speculation. If true, it would mean wartime German disc know-how passed into Western secret programs.
